channel.title: South Florida Sun Sentinel - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Florida Sun Sentinel (sunsentinel.com)

item.title: Man sentenced to 8 years after Lauderhill shooting led to ID theft investigation
item.description: A Broward man was sentenced to eight years in prison after a drive-by shooting in Lauderhill led to the discovery of "a calculated fraud operation,” federal prosecutors announced Tuesday.

item.title: Government fines businesses over 6 deaths at Colorado dairy
item.description: Federal workplace safety regulators fined three businesses over their failure to protect six dairy workers.

item.title: Unnamed couple agrees to genetic testing in embryo mix-up case
item.description: They could be the biological parents of a baby girl born in December to a Brevard County couple, who, after IVF, gave birth to a child who is not biologically theirs.

item.title: New Hampshire resident charged in shooting at Canadian border
item.description: Prosecutors said the case is still under investigation and the FBI is taking the lead.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: President Donald Trump's State of the Union address is tilting heavily on domestic issues, but he's also making the case for his foreign policy efforts.

item.title: Heat fizzle late amid Bucks’ closing sizzle, falling 128-117 in Milwaukee
item.description: The Miami Heat had all their weapons; the Milwaukee Bucks were lacking their leading man. Didn't matter, with Erik Spoelstra's team losing Tuesday night.

item.title: Winderman’s view: First the fashion police, then an arresting loss for Heat in Milwaukee
item.description: Ira Winderman's perspectives and other items of note from the Miami Heat's Tuesday night game against the Milwaukee Bucks.

item.title: Trump honors National Guard members shot in Washington
item.description: Air Force Staff Sgt. Andrew Wolfe was presented the Purple Heart medal during Trump’s State of the Union.

item.title: Reneau’s 23, Donaldson’s 21 lift Miami Hurricanes over Florida State
item.description: Malik Reneau scored 23 points and grabbed 12 rebounds, Tre Donaldson had 21 points, six assists, and six rebounds as Miami held on late to defeat Florida State on Tuesday night.

item.title: Army pilot wounded in Maduro raid gets Congressional Medal of Honor during Trump’s speech
item.description: Army Chief Warrant Officer 5 Eric Slover was the pilot of the helicopter that descended on the 'heavily protected military fortress.'
